notes: RBox revision of functionality: capital_of (a city is the national capital of at most one country) loses it. Every model answers the direct question correctly, so the property is held. Functionality follows from no other tag of capital_of (inverse, subproperty of located_in, chain). geography-replace-0012 edits a different property of the same relation. The instances ask what the given fact rules out or allows, 'given only this'. The first instance (and the cross-lingual queries) asks whether the fact rules out a second country (yes, then no), the second whether a second country is possible (no, then yes). Near asks the same property of 'is the largest city of' (no). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
